scripts.app:build: npm run helper && APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 NO_STRIP=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$PWD/src-tauri/binaries${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}" tauri build
scripts.helper: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --release -p balota-workshop --locked && mkdir -p src-tauri/binaries && cp src-tauri/target/release/balota-workshop "src-tauri/binaries/balota-workshop-$(rustc -vV | sed -n 's/^host: //p')" && bash scripts/fetch-steam-lib.sh
